maintenance_led.reason: Sells mostly single-use medical devices (Arrow catheters, LMA airways, UroLift, QuikClot) used up in procedures, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Sells to hospitals, paid mainly by private and commercial insurers and patients; government programs are only part of payment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own medical device products and innovation; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Clinician-trained, regulator-cleared devices like Arrow vascular access catheters and UroLift are hard to switch because of training and clinical risk.

notes: Payer mix judged from general knowledge, not the website text.
